task: Classify candidate engineering claims against bounded admitted original-source evidence.
instructions: Judge evidence support, not whether an installation is safe or engineering-approved.
Supported requires evidence for all material parts at the claimed entity, time and configuration scope.
Contradicted requires an explicit incompatible fact for that same scope; a missing statement alone is insufficient-evidence.
Use insufficient-evidence if admitted sources leave the claim unresolved. Historical truth does not establish current installed truth.
Alarm/notification, automatic action and remote action have distinct meanings and endpoints.
Keep source literals, unavailable values, zero, blank fields, document revisions and individual timestamps distinct.
Do not infer deployment history, job execution or physical condition from publication metadata or filenames.
Use only each item's admitted evidence IDs and the source identity/time metadata; do not use external knowledge or other items's evidence.

evidence.locator: 2016 Devices.xml physical lines 691-692; 2017 Devices.xml physical lines 463-464; Device element and Description.
evidence.paraphrase: Both pinned XML versions give the device name and id as Hurco04 and UUID as mtc_adapter008; the Description identifies manufacturer Hurco and model VMX24.
evidence.time_scope: Comparison of the two published git versions, not deployed revision or live identity verification.

evidence.locator: 2016 Devices.xml physical line 724; 2017 Devices.xml physical line 496; Device[@id='Hurco04']//DataItem[@id='Hurco04-path_7'].
evidence.paraphrase: In the older XML, Hurco04-path_7 is named current_tool and typed TOOL_NUMBER. In the later XML, that same id string is named Program_Runtime_Seconds and typed ACCUMULATED_TIME, with SECOND units.
evidence.time_scope: Different published historical document revisions; their definitions are not simultaneous readings.

evidence.locator: Archived raw log physical lines 3 and 34, preserving each timestamp, item and value.
evidence.paraphrase: At 2017-02-14T16:12:54.968217Z the Spindle_Speed value is the literal UNAVAILABLE. At 2017-02-17T09:18:51.4531250Z the Spindle_Speed value is numeric 0. These are separate records with different timestamps and different literal values.
evidence.time_scope: Only the two archived samples at their exact timestamps; no inferred interpolation.

evidence.locator: Source filename Hurco04-20170217-20170218.txt and physical line 3.
evidence.paraphrase: Despite the date strings in its filename, this archive includes a Spindle_Speed record timestamped 2017-02-14T16:12:54.968217Z, whose value is UNAVAILABLE.
evidence.time_scope: An included timestamp predating February 17, 2017; no filename-derived completeness claim.

evidence.locator: All 363 raw physical lines inspected for field format; example line 81; paired XML identities at 2016 lines 691-692 and 2017 lines 463-464.
evidence.paraphrase: Each raw line has timestamp, item name and value separated by vertical bars; no deployed-configuration revision field appears. Line 81 records Spindle_Speed as 1000.000000 at 2017-02-17T09:26:08.0468750Z. The two published XML files share machine identity, but neither supplies deployment history for this log.
evidence.time_scope: Historical archive and two published XML revisions; no installation or deployment record admitted.

evidence.locator: Raw physical lines 37, 45 and 359, preserving the single-space program name value at line 37.
evidence.paraphrase: At 2017-02-17T09:18:51.4531250Z Program_Name_Running contains one space, and Program_Status is READY. At 2017-02-17T09:40:46.755688Z Program_Status is UNAVAILABLE. None of these records names a production job or documents continuous execution.
evidence.time_scope: The specific archived observations only; no complete production-state timeline.
